web.title: Most expensive page of comic art sold at auction
web.description:
3,360,000 US dollar(s)

The most expensive page of comic art sold at auction is page 25 of _Marvel Super-Heroes Secret Wars #8_, which was sold for $3,360,000 (£2,458,880 / €2,948,010) by Heritage Auctions, on 13 January 2022.

Page 24 of the same comic was also sold as part of the action, fetching $288,000!

The sale greatly surpasses the previous record of $657,250 paid for a page of _The Incredible Hulk_(1974) which featured the rise of Wolverine.

web.title: A Record-Breaking Sale: Two 10-Cent Comic Books Sell for $13 Million
web.description:
# A Record-Breaking Sale: Two 10-Cent Comic Books Sell for $13 Million
## Highest-graded Batman No. 1 teams up with second highest-graded Superman No. 1 in blockbuster Heritage Auctions transaction.
###### [Heritage Auctions](https://www.antiquetrader.com/author/heritage-auctions)
![](https://www.antiquetrader.com/uploads/2026/02/Batman-comic.jpeg?format=auto&optimize=high&width=1440)

5, 2026) — Heritage Auctions, in collaboration with SemperFi Comics, has completed one of the largest private comic transactions ever recorded, involving two comic books once purchased at the newsstand for 10 cents each: a [_Batman_ No. 1 CGC 9.4](https://nam02.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcomics.ha.com%2Fitm%2Fgolden-age-1938-1955-%2Fsuperhero%2Fbatman-1-dc-1940-cgc-nm-94-white-pages%2Fa%2F7239-91027.s&data=05%7C02%7Ckelejohnson%40aimmedia.com%7C754cc151b8a942f62dcf08de64d62427%7C8e799f8afc0b4171a6cfb7070a2ae405%7C0%7C0%7C639059068066583174%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=hn8%2BrbV%2Bw0GQxNhKQX%2B8jcFHcZoj%2FxCjk%2F5RZ0lJMmk%3D&reserved=0), the highest-graded known copy, for $6 million, alongside the second highest-graded copy of _Superman_ No. 1, [a CGC 8.5 Mile High pedigree](https://nam02.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Furldefense.com%2Fv3%2F__https%3A%2Fwww.cgccomics.com%2Fcertlookup%2F1072525001%2F__%3B!!FwDVRb0n2SqcGUGF!jNcPFvylJpbXtCiW6KH3ItaxGVZ5APL4t9OU4HGbZmnK6tkxDYz64JjVKt8h0O9ZJmoQNgb3BQ%24&data=05%7C02%7Ckelejohnson%40aimmedia.com%7C754cc151b8a942f62dcf08de64d62427%7C8e799f8afc0b4171a6cfb7070a2ae405%7C0%7C0%7C639059068066605107%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=T0sF%2F%2F9KBqAMTOZ%2F38%2BddWbPwScIeuXo%2FIFhAwf4638%3D&reserved=0) copy, for $7 million.

Following November’s record-setting [$9.12 million auction sale of _Superman_ No. 1 CGC 9.0](https://nam02.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcomics.ha.com%2Fitm%2Fgolden-age-1938-1955-%2Fsuperhero%2Fsuperman-1-dc-1939-cgc-vf-nm-90-off-white-to-white-pages%2Fa%2F7427-93015.s&data=05%7C02%7Ckelejohnson%40aimmedia.com%7C754cc151b8a942f62dcf08de64d62427%7C8e799f8afc0b4171a6cfb7070a2ae405%7C0%7C0%7C639059068066629776%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=JdzkEaI8kBZYuNNxHYVOIJ4m4lvjC1DBf33jrY4ftXs%3D&reserved=0), Heritage Consignment Director Nathan Howerton saw an opportunity to place two more historic treasures owned by a longtime Heritage client and personal friend.
